narration.text: Twelve IRS notices sorted: first-time abatement requested on four penalties the owner's record qualifies for, one on tax still being paid, while a second quarter, an earlier penalty in a history, accuracy and estimated tax penalties, a second partnership year, an abated penalty and two non-penalty notices are left alone. This is a chore for the owner of a small millwork company in Duluth, Minnesota, who co-owns two partnerships and has a bookkeeper who scanned the IRS letters but never called the number on them. On the bench, she found 4 of 4 eligible items, worth 1,850 dollars and 60 cents of the 1,850 dollars and 60 cents there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 8 traps, and she walked past 8. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 2 hours, so she was about 71 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
